rows.en: Like hell I'll miss this scoop!
I was an idiot to expect anything from you.
Can't believe I, of all people, picked such a lousy subject.
Honestly, I'm amazed you made it back alive.
Good work! I'm counting on you next time too!
Glad you made it back in one piece.
I'm shooting the moment of success. Give me a good face!
rows.notes: toru heard in the wrong kanji (take vs film).

rows.en: Picking you as my subject was the right call.
You're the subject I picked! Of course you can pull this off!
You saved me! Thanks to you, I got some great footage!
Man, you're something. I'm moved to tears by our friendship!
rows.notes: Transcript "an-ato-san" unclear, probably "anta (tte yatsu) wa". otoko no yuujou (friendship between men): 320-331 are the male-partner lines.

rows.en: With you, I feel like I can land even bigger scoops.
You're the best partner I could ask for!
Figures. With you, I couldn't get any footage the viewers would like.
Choosing you as my subject was a mistake from the start.
rows.notes: Transcript "ana kara" is "hana kara" (from the start).

rows.en: I'm amazed you made it back alive, flying like that.
Not bad at all! Good work!
Get me a scoop next time too. I'm counting on you.
Your skills weren't bad at all.
Thanks to you, I got some great footage. Thanks a lot.
I don't mind that reckless streak of yours.
Skilled as ever. Let's keep working together.
You really are a picture-perfect subject. I'm in awe.
To thank you for the great footage, let me buy you a meal.
rows.notes: rei (thanks) written with the wrong kanji in the transcript.

rows.en: A behind-the-scenes documentary about you could be fun too.
Why do the Zentradi have songs?
I won't lose!
Stop it!
I'll land that scoop, no matter what.
My report will stop this war! All right, let's do this!
Silvie, are you okay?
Yeah, I came to rescue you.
Thanks, Silvie. You believed in me.
What's that...?
Yeah.
rows.notes: 0.8 s "aa"; could be a reply or a gasp. Read as a reply.

rows.en: We open every comm channel on the Macross. Let's try it, Silvie.
Aren't we here because we believe in the Macross's power too?
Why not take one more chance? On Ars's ship.
rows.notes: Ars: glossary entry is provisional. kakeru read as "gamble on". Could also be a mishearing.

rows.en: Ishtar's kindness is reaching everyone's hearts.
I came to catch Silvie in action on camera!
Silvie Gena, launching!
Ready to sortie. Here we go!
I'm launching too. Go!
Look out!
Not good enough.
rows.notes: amai wa ne (too naive / too soft).

rows.en: No problem.
You'll pay for that.
You're the worst.
And this one too!
No!
This is bad!
Tch!
I can't dodge it!
Here's a little extra!
You're wide open.
You won't get away.
Go!
I'll show you what I can do!
Failure isn't an option! I'll pull this off, no matter what!
I'll be your opponent.
Enemy acquired.
Come and get me!
This ends now!
I'm betting everything on this strike!
Here I go!
Give it up!
You still want more?
Is that your best?
Sorry about this.
You're no match for me.
How weak.
Target confirmed.
If I can take that down...
I'll take down the target.
